label: Software as a service (web app, subscription)
default_stack: Static front end on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; app back end on a free tier (Cloudflare Workers, Fly.io, Supabase) declared as code; Stripe Checkout behind an environment variable, off until the owner adds a key.

questions.ask: Who is the first customer, as specifically as you can say it (job, company size, situation)?
questions.default: Agent picks the narrowest customer the idea serves and writes it down for you to correct.

questions.ask: What do they do today instead, and what does that cost them?
questions.default: Agent researches public forums and competitor pages and records what it finds, with links.

questions.ask: What would you like to charge, and is a free tier acceptable?
questions.default: Free tier plus one paid plan priced at the median of three named competitors.

questions.ask: Do you have a name, domain or brand colours already?
questions.default: Agent proposes three names; the first is used until you pick one.

questions.ask: Which country will the business be registered in (affects tax, privacy law and payments)?
questions.default: United States; privacy pages also cover GDPR basics.

questions.ask: How many hours a week can you give it (approvals, sales calls, account sign-ups)?
questions.default: Two hours a week, batched into one owner checklist.

owner_setup.what: Decide whether to trade as yourself or register a company (LLC, Ltd).
owner_setup.why: Liability and tax; an agent cannot sign registration forms.

owner_setup.what: Open a separate business bank account.
owner_setup.why: Keeps the books clean; needs your ID.

owner_setup.what: Create a Stripe (or Paddle / Lemon Squeezy) account and add the secret key as a repository or hosting secret.
owner_setup.why: Payment code ships off by default and switches on only with your key.

owner_setup.what: Buy the domain the agent proposes in BUSINESS.md and point it at the host in SETUP.md.
Create a support mailbox (or forwarding address) on the domain.
owner_setup.why: Customers need a reply-to address; the agent drafts replies, you send them.
